question.text: Mrs. Gupta invests Rs. 5 lakh in a debt fund at 3:30 PM on a business day via RTGS, and the funds are credited and available for utilization only after the 3 PM cut-off. Which NAV will be applicable?

answer.text: Same day's NAV since payment was made via RTGS
Next business day's NAV, because the funds became available for utilization only after the 3 PM cut-off
The higher of same day or next day NAV
No NAV will apply until the amount exceeds Rs. 10 lakh

explanation.text: The Logic: For purchases in equity and debt schemes (of any amount), the applicable NAV is the NAV of the business day on which the funds are available for utilization before the 3 PM cut-off, irrespective of the time of receipt of the application. Here the funds become available only after the 3 PM cut-off, so the next business day's NAV applies. The Trap: RTGS provides immediate fund transfer but does not, by itself, secure the same day's NAV — the rule is funds-available-before-cut-off. The applicable-NAV rule does not turn on the time of application receipt for purchases. Note: Source: NISM Series V-A (Mutual Fund Distributors) workbook, pp.190-191 — applicable NAV for equity/debt purchases is governed by funds-available-for-utilization before the 3 PM cut-off, irrespective of application receipt time.
